description: NBU monetary aggregates (M0, M1, M2, M3 money supply, in UAH million) for a given month. Each record: {dt (YYYYMMDD), txt (Ukrainian name), txten (English name), id_api (e.g. M2/M3), value, freq}. `date` selects the reference month (any day in it); omit for the latest available month.

date.description: Reference day inside the month, YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240101". Omit for latest.

name: nbu_monetary_aggregates
